readings: Considering only tracks whose file size (`Track.Bytes`) is more than 10,323,804 bytes, work out for each media type (by name) the average bytes per millisecond (`Bytes` ÷ `Milliseconds`) of its tracks. Which media types have an average strictly higher than the simple average of all these per-media-type averages? Show the media type name, its average, and how far it is above that overall average (its average minus the overall average). Leave all values unrounded.
queries:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT mt.Name AS Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bpm
  FROM Track t
  JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804
  GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
)
SELECT Name, avg_bpm, avg_bpm - (SELECT AVG(avg_bpm) FROM m) AS diff
FROM m
WHERE avg_bpm > (SELECT AVG(avg_bpm) FROM m);
